title: ismissing
summary: Return a logical mask identifying missing entries.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered before missingness is inspected.

description: `ismissing(A)` returns a logical result with true values where `A` contains missing data.
behaviors: Numeric and complex values are missing when any stored component is `NaN`.
String values are missing when they equal `<missing>` case-insensitively.
Character-array rows are missing when blank or equal to `<missing>`.
Tables return a height-by-width logical array, one column per table variable.
Datetime and duration objects are treated as missing when their internal numeric representation contains `NaN`.

examples.output: M is a logical matrix with one column per table variable.
